As the granddaughter of an iron ore miner, I am honored to earn the endorsement of the United Steelworkers District 11, representing 13,000 workers. 

Steelworkers have built Minnesota and our country. I’ve worked with them on serious economic issues like steel dumping from foreign countries. As Governor, I'll fight for good-paying union jobs.

Today at the Nelson family farm outside Moorhead, my running mate Ben Schierer and I unveiled our plan to expand Minnesota's rural and agricultural economy.

The farm has been in the Nelson family for four generations and we need to keep it that way. Their 100-year-old grandma Dorothy was there and agrees!
